summary: Fox Corporation filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of Roku, Inc. under a June 14, 2026 merger agreement. The two-step structure merges Roku into Falcon Merger Sub 1, then the survivor into Falcon Merger Sub 2, making Roku a wholly owned FOX subsidiary. On September 8, 2026, both parties received a DOJ Second Request, extending the HSR waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium was restated. FOX still targets closing in the first half of calendar 2027, subject to HSR clearance and both stockholder votes.
